notes.title: Beta Release 3.3.0B
notes.notes:
Beta 3.3.0 is available which contains all planned game elements (except pike). By now new stage pack LOS3 is available with 8 stages containing new gameplay elements.
New elements are also available in the editor.
Beta is available on 'beta' branch. Password 'siaburabujek'.

notes.title: Update 3.1.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Support for german language
[*]Smooth in game camera movement
[/list]
(there were much more done in development but it waits dormant for bigger update)

notes.title: Aktualizacja 3.1.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed error that number of cones to collect was decrementing when cones were destroyed by exposion
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3.1.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added detecting of 3 new small achievements
[*] Fix. When getting back from stage editor to stage pack view currently edited stage is selected
[*] Improvement. In editor when item is selected toolbox is switched to last used draw operation
[*] Calibrated volume of distanced sounds
[*] Fix. Now adding points is blocked after Moose Death.
[*] Fix. Now user can enter polish stage name (when language set to polish)
[*] Improvement. User can use move controls to change language in language view
[*] Pressing F2 toggles fixed frames time.
[*] When testing stage and stage has time set, time is enabled.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3.1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix that user could not enter new stage set name
[*] Fixed that cones on stage count update was broken
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3.1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Initial integration with Steamworks API
[*] Added some achievements related to finishing stage packs. Unfortunately current stage pack progress is taken into consideration only for not timed achievements versions.
[*] Game language on first run is set based on Steam client language
[*] Indicating mouse hovering on form properties (stage editor)
[/list]

notes.title: Update V3.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Editor view is drawn in constant size resolution then scaled to viewport
[*] Moose is dropping multiple puffballs by keeping button pressed - no need to press it multiple times
[/list]

notes.title: Update V3.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed UI options in Stage Pack Management and Edit Stage Pack views:
- Not available options are not visible
- Confirmation splash screens are properly handled by GamePad
[*] Improved text rotating using GamePad. Up/Down is auto repeating.
[*] Pressing GamePad Start/Menu button in StagePackManagement and EditStagePack shows up left menu
[*] Fixed that now checkbox in EditorHelp page can be toggled by GamePad A button
[*] Pressing GamePad Start/Menu on StageEditor will focus right toolbar
[*] Fixed that on StagePack selection screen title can be clicked by mouse and is hoverable
[*] Hotkeys are not shown in Editor when GamePad is used
[/list]
